items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active and expected to play vs Panthers after Rapoport expected-to-go report.
items.why: Calf progressing; player planned to play.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers (knee) status murky for SNF vs Cowboys; up to him after full practices. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre. Main slate news locked otherwise.
items.why: Post-ACL recovery; player decision. Elevations signal caution.
items.implication: If out/limited, targets to Fields/Mooney/Likely bounce. Projections updating only on this.
items.opportunity: If IN, high target share; if OUT, WR2/TE upside

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions after full Friday practice but not quite ready.
items.why: Knee not fully ready despite full participation late week.
items.implication: Unchallenged lead back role opens for Etienne.
items.opportunity: Bulk carries + passing downs for backup

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown no surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed no surgery needed.
items.implication: Long-term absence; NE WR depth elevated.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers. Team monitoring feel this week.
items.implication: Mayer primary TE; short-term TE waiver value.

items.text: Cooper Rush expected/active to start for Falcons vs Steelers (back better); Tua/Penix inactive. Zaccheaus emergency QB/RB. Only Bijan/Brian Robinson active at RB.
items.why: Back improved; dual emergency roles noted.

items.text: Kamara inactive status boosts Travis Etienne projection significantly as unchallenged lead with Miller as RB2.
items.why: Kamara out opens bulk work including passing downs.
items.implication: Top-10 RB upside for Etienne in NO-DET (up-tempo).
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone with Kamara absent

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play vs Chargers per weekend reports and Rapoport.
items.why: Ankle progressing well; limited practices but HC positive.
items.implication: Rookie RB involvement as RB2/possible lead.

items.text: Buccaneers elevated RB Josh Williams; Sean Tucker doubtful (hamstring). Bucky Irving/Gainwell split expected.
Isaiah Likely ranks high in points per target; with Nabers not 100% and weak WR2 options (Fields/Mooney), load up on Likely.
items.why: 4th in TE FPTS/target; 8/9 games with 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR. Nabers limited.
items.implication: Strong TE start if Nabers limited/out.

items.text: Main slate news largely locked; no major projection changes expected beyond Nabers update. Projections live and updating.
items.implication: Trust current ETR projections for 1pm slate.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; Berry keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex option amid CAR RB situation.

items.text: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow slog. Full snaps/pace available. CHI/CAR total jumped.
items.implication: Boost volume for NO/DET skill players; fade MIA/LV pace.

items.text: When MHJ plays 50%+ snaps, Michael Wilson averages 5.5 PPG/13% share; jumps to 28% without him. MHJ expected.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ plays full.
items.opportunity: Limited for Wilson; full for MHJ

items.text: Saquon Barkley averages 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 games vs WAS (incl playoffs); WAS front still below average.
Chris Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Tyler Shough; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U.
items.why: Shough chemistry + DET secondary injuries + high total.

items.text: Parker Washington averaged 24% target share on 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share. Ward shadows BTJ vs CLE.
Justin Herbert FPTS/pass attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year. Alt healthy; ARI DL/secondary weak (PFF 31/26).
items.why: OL health + soft ARI pass rush/coverage.
